checks: The Commonwealth publishes separate goods determinations for Norfolk Island, Christmas Island and the Cocos (Keeling) Islands. A covered item may be prohibited or require compliance with conditions, including a permit.
Goods moving from the Australian mainland to the specifically named external island; territory-specific determinations
Australian Department of Agriculture, Fisheries and Forestry
Check the specific island, commodity and route. Consult the relevant determination and BICON before packing. Passenger and conveyance procedures differ.

Australian government guidance says a passport and visa are unnecessary for travel from mainland Australia to Norfolk Island, but each passenger must produce acceptable photographic identification for clearance.
Mainland Australia to Norfolk Island; traveling passengers including children
Check accepted identity documents and passport requirements for itineraries or diversions through another country.
Passengers arriving from mainland Australia must fill in an incoming passenger card and may have baggage inspected.
Norfolk Island arrivals from mainland Australia
Check item declaration conditions and requirements for any origin outside mainland Australia.
Norfolk Island National Park is included in Parks Australia's permit process for filming. A park manager can waive the requirement for news of the day under the stated guidance.
Norfolk Island National Park; covered media and other filming under Parks Australia guidance
Check commercial versus personal use, equipment, local site rules and whether an approval is needed in addition to the filming permit.
Roads on Christmas Island are temporarily closed during stages of the red crab migration. The park authority publishes current road restrictions and asks users to follow signs and directions.
Christmas Island roads affected by seasonal migration
Parks Australia, Christmas Island National Park
Check live alerts and posted signs. Seasonal road closures differ from permanent access and walking restrictions.

Tokelau's government directs foreign visitors to obtain an entry permit and contact the processing office a month in advance. The office issues permits after receiving approval from the appropriate village.
Check relevant atoll or village, sea access via Samoa, carrier arrangements and separate Samoa transit eligibility.

Niue Immigration's express-lane notice allows covered travelers to use an online arrival declaration and still requires stated portions of the paper arrival card, including customs and biosecurity information.
Niue airport procedures for the returning residents and regular visitors identified by the immigration notice
Check first-time visitor procedures, physical card fields, and live directions. A digital submission does not establish a waiver of customs or biosecurity declarations.
Niue Immigration requires passport scanning during the online declaration workflow, and its airport instructions describe an inspection step for travelers who have already submitted online.
Niue airport departures using online declaration
Check paper alternatives and any separate customs export or airport requirements.
Bonaire imposes a visitor entry tax for covered nonresidents arriving by air or sea. Its authority publishes a standard rate, documentary exceptions and a cruise-line collection procedure.
Bonaire only; excludes other islands sharing the BQ identifier
Check age and residency exceptions, cruise versus other sea arrivals, proof at entry and re-entry validity. Verify Saba and Sint Eustatius separately.
The Aruba Tourism Authority directs visitors to the online Embarkation and Disembarkation Card and describes a USD 20 sustainability fee integrated into that workflow for covered air arrivals.
Aruba visitor air arrivals under the online ED Card system
Check fee exceptions and submission timing, official immigration rules and procedures for arrivals by sea.
The Cayman Islands agriculture department requires import permits for arriving animals and publishes separate conditions for dogs and cats.
Cayman Islands; arriving live animals and pet-specific requirements
Check the current dog and cat conditions, origin, transit, vaccinations, eligibility and inspection. Confirm requirements for other species separately.

The published customs declaration card requires arriving travelers to declare covered currency and negotiable instruments totaling CI$10,000 or more or equivalent and provide particulars on the reporting form.
Cayman Islands Customs and Border Control
Verify the latest form, aggregation and definitions. Check vessel arrivals and departure obligations separately.
The Turks and Caicos customs authority directs each arriving air passenger or family representative to complete and sign a passenger declaration.
Turks and Caicos Islands; arrivals by plane and customs declarations
Check which passengers may file together and whether a digital or maritime arrival process applies.
Border Force requires the international money-transport report for covered amounts exceeding USD 10,000 or equivalent entering or leaving the territory.
Turks and Caicos Islands; inbound and outbound, covered cash and instruments
Turks and Caicos Islands Border Force
Compare the customs arrival page at exactly USD 10,000. Verify the current legal threshold, aggregate amounts and application by port.
The customs air-arrival instructions use USD 10,000 or more. The Border Force cash guidance uses more than USD 10,000. The obligation at exactly USD 10,000 needs reconciliation.
Turks and Caicos Islands; passengers arriving by air; exact threshold conflict
Turks and Caicos Islands Customs and Border Force
Compare https://borderforce.gov.tc/cash-allowances and the current law or form; retain the conflicting evidence.

Bermuda's Customs Department put revised Customs Form 98 into effect on 1 October 2026. It covers arrivals and departures; the transition period for accepting the superseded form ended 31 October 2026.
Bermuda Customs Traveller Declaration; air and sea procedures as published
Check how the form is issued on the planned route and distinguish it from visitor immigration paperwork and US preclearance.
The British Virgin Islands government provides an animal import permit application and requires satisfaction of applicable entry conditions before processing the permit.
British Virgin Islands; application for arrival with an animal
Government of the British Virgin Islands
Check current application, health certificates, species and origin restrictions and appointment or processing requirements.

Pitcairn publishes an advance long-term visitor visa process for visits longer than 14 days. It calls for supporting medical and police documentation and a decision by the Governor after consultation.
Check the current application process, extensions and whether a different travel pattern makes short-term admission unavailable.
Tristan da Cunha's government specifies health insurance covering medical evacuation to Cape Town for visitors staying on the island.
Confirm policy language, health clearance and any distinct rules for a ship passenger making only a brief landing.
The Tristan visit guidance requires stay-over visitors to have confirmed paid return passage and sufficient funds for their stay.
Tristan da Cunha stay-over visitors; planning and permission conditions
Check visit permission, deposit or payment arrangements and vessel-dependent conditions.

Tristan requires planned special projects, including covered film work, to be declared in writing and approved. The published film project conditions also provide for review by the Island Council before release.
Tristan da Cunha; film crews and defined special projects
Ordinary personal snapshots are outside the scope of this source. Confirm which productions qualify, fees, assurance requirements and approval timing.
Saint Helena publishes an airport drone map and urges prior discussion with the Harbour Master for flights within port limits or close to harbour operations.
Island of Saint Helena only; airport and harbour operational areas
Verify binding airspace permissions separately from the harbour advice. Do not apply this rule to Ascension or Tristan da Cunha.
Falkland Islands Police guidance describes a cumulative 12-month limit for use of a current valid foreign driving licence and the exchange process for continued driving.
Falkland Islands; foreign driver licences and exchange procedure
Royal Falkland Islands Police Licensing Bureau
Check licence class, any later amendments and acceptable documentation. Vehicle and rental conditions are separate.
UK official travel guidance identifies advance mooring permits for yacht crews making a qualifying safe passage through the outer islands and asks for travel insurance proof.
British Indian Ocean Territory guidance for permitted yacht passage, outer islands only
UK Foreign, Commonwealth and Development Office
Confirm currently operative authority, eligible routing, access limits and applicability in light of jurisdictional change. Diego Garcia has separate access rules.
The Bahamas Customs Management Regulations provide for a passenger baggage declaration upon entry, including baggage and the goods carried.
Check current amendments, electronic submission, individual or family filing and distinct cash reporting obligations.
